name: Veronica
source:
Witch Magician.

One of the five witches handpicked by demon Zenohemia over a decade ago. She holds dominion over the lycanthropes who inhabit Bars forest and its environs in the southern reaches of Legulus island.

A magician of immense power, she specialises in flame and heat magic but is also capable of manipulating a wide variety of other spells. 

Her appearance is extremely sultry and sensuous. She transforms males she takes a liking to into lycanthropes under the control. Her favourite lycanthrope is possessed by a demon and serves as her right hand. (Currently the lycanthrope Schtoll has this honour).

Before Zenohemia bestowed her with demonic possession, she was bullied in the village she lived in. She despises humans because of this.

[Spoiler] The first witch Gil fights and defeats. After her demon is exorcised, Norn chooses not to kill her to take vengeance for her parents and chooses instead to take her to the nearest town for judgment.

During her incarceration, the prison guards take turns to rape Veronica which feeds her hatred of humans. When Zenohemia gives her a second chance with a more powerful demon than the first one, she gleefully seizes her chance to escape captivity and take revenge against the rapist guards.

If Gil falls during the Crimson Moon ritual, Veronica enjoys her vengeance against her former compatriots who betrayed Zenohemia.

Veronica fights Gil and his party three times over the course of the game. After the third battle, she reaches her limit and collapses. Her fate is left unsaid, but it is assumed she dies either from her wounds or from drowning when the underground temple collapses on itself. [/Spoiler]
